newsitem.title: JAPAN: Aramco hikes Nov propane and butane prices to $250.
newsitem.headline: Aramco hikes Nov propane and butane prices to $250.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's state-owned oil firm Saudi Aramco said on Wednesday that it had raised its November contract prices for propane and butane by $45 from the previous month to $250 per tonne.
The November prices are the highest since Aramco introduced contract prices as a benchmark for its liquefied petroleum gas cargoes in October 1994.
The previous high was $230 per tonne for propane and $233 for butane for February 1995.
The Saudi contract price is loosely based on the results of three monthly spot tenders and the company's own assessment of spot market trends.
